name: Global Ecosystem-based Adaptation (EbA) Fund
program: Global EbA Fund, medium-size (up to USD 500,000) and small-size (up to USD 250,000) grants
collect_note: Reads both Global EbA Fund call pages (medium-size and small-size grants) from the site menu and takes each page's own 'Submission Window ... to <date>' closing date twice a day; both 2026 windows have closed, and a new window on either page shows up as a new open call.

evidence: Checked 2026-11-12. https://globalebafund.org/medium-size-grants/ HTTP 200 static WordPress HTML, text 'Submission Window: 12 October to 16 November 2026'. /feed/ HTTP 200 RSS but has no items; /wp-json/wp/v2/posts returns [] (only posts, pages and media types, no calls type); /news/ lists events and updates only, with no per-call listing; the small-size page (https://globalebafund.org/small-size-grants/, window 28 Sep to 26 Oct 2026, closed) has the same layout but is not tracked. No Grants.gov or EU API applies (IKI funds via IUCN and UNEP). Calls are downloaded and submitted on an online platform, no public portal list.
